title: Topological invariance over an affine target
statement: Let r:X→Y be a morphism whose every base change is a homeomorphism [def-weil-universal-homeomorphism], with Y affine. Then the actual direct image on Type (u+1)-valued small pro-etale sheaves is an equivalence.

proof.text: Convert the universally-homeomorphic hypothesis to the integral universal-homeomorphism class. The base-changed affine basis is a dense subsite, so its restriction on set sheaves is an equivalence. The sheaf pushforward composition isomorphism identifies this restriction with r_* followed by restriction to Y.AffineProEt. That latter restriction is itself an equivalence by the affine-basis comparison theorem. Cancel it to obtain that r_* is an equivalence.
